owns: B91 D4/D5 Hydro observations against plan.bills. Not a utility-account subsystem, not an accounts-payable ledger, and not a second calendar.
does_not_own: Permission to write data.json, Forecast results, live Hydro amounts, or positions.csv rows.

observations.label: BC Hydro account balance
observations.note: Informational utility account state. Must not become a scheduled cash event. The dated dues are the cash requirements. Only an explicit hydro-account-balance bill row is the forbidden scheduled form of this amount.

observations.label: BC Hydro current due
observations.note: Dated household cash requirement due now as of the Aug. 14 observation. Not the $451.24 account balance.

observations.label: BC Hydro due 1 September
observations.note: Dated household cash requirement due 2026-09-01. Not the $451.24 account balance. Owner 2026-09-09 equal-payment $199 from the next bill is a separate canonical bill (hydro-equal-payment), not this once due.

observations.label: BC Hydro equal payment from next bill
observations.note: Owner 2026-09-09 BC Hydro annual-adjustment notice: equal monthly payments become $199.00 on the next bill. Owner document 2026-11-03 (the 2026-10-08 bill) evidences the plan amount unchanged at $199.00 and a due date of 2026-10-30 (that bill's total due, net of the account credit, was paid 2026-11-03); dueDate here is that evidenced day and is still ESTIMATED as a monthly cadence because one bill evidences it. Superseded estimate: firstDue 2026-10-01, the next-bill-month start, was never a confirmed payment day. The −$53.08 Hydro-account credit is encoded on the bill as first-occurrence netting, not as this dated-due amount. Owner MyHydro screenshot this turn corroborates $53.08 Credit still on the account; the 5 Sep–6 Oct 2026 billing period is a period window only, not a due. Not a usage-based amount. Not the 1 September $237.45 once due.

observations.label: BC Hydro account credit
observations.note: MyHydro current balance $53.08 Credit; 9 September 2026 bill amount −$53.08. Informational utility-account state. Must not become a scheduled cash event or 9 September chequing income. Forecast nets it from the first hydro-equal-payment cash occurrence. The 5 September–6 October 2026 billing period on the same screen is a period window only, not a payment or due date.

observations.label: BC Hydro paying account
observations.note: Attribution/funding route. Does not erase household-obligation status. DEBT&PAYMENTS is held-elsewhere, not joint spendable cash.
